# 6.2.4.9 Slab Allocator Statistics

Two forms of slab statistics are available: global statistics and per-cache statistics. The global statistics are available through the crash utility and display a summary of the entire cache list managed by the allocator.

```
# crash
dumpfile = /dev/mem, namelist = /dev/ksym, outfile = stdout
> kmastat
```
